_about: Wiki pages this project's data is copied from, and the revision each was last verified against. Read by the weekly source-watch task (see data/SOURCE_WATCH.md) to tell whether our copy has fallen behind. Pinning a revid is the only reliable staleness signal: the pages' own {{version}} tags have proven unreliable - the Relics tag read 4.5 on 2026-09-26 and reads 3.14 today, having moved backwards.

pages.note: Captured at 119679 when the page was tagged {{Version|4.5}}. The page has since been edited and re-tagged {{version|3.14}} - a version tag moving backwards. Re-capture with data/tools/capture/capture_relics.js (browser console; the wiki blocks scripted clients), then diff the five consumed fields: passive, triumph, triumph_cost, triumph_cooldown_days, activatable.

Captured 2026-08-30 by reading the page, not by a pinned capture, so the revid it saw is unknown. 120113 is the revision monitoring started from, NOT a revision our data was verified against. Changes are detected from 2026-10-15 forward; anything between August and now is unmeasured.
Same caveat as Astral_rift: baseline, not a verified match.

also_watch.what: Paradox patch notes and dev diaries
also_watch.why: The wiki lags the game. A patch that touches astral rifts, dig sites or relics is a staleness warning even when no wiki page has changed yet - which is exactly the state this project was in through September.
